messages:
morgan: Quick notewe're seeing duplicate fallback events when quota backfills hit shortly after a soft_degrade. Console shows two flips for the same request id. Anyone else? :confused:
sri: Which fields differ? If it's identical decisions we could dedupe at ingest.
elena: The second event has reason=quota_backfill but same decision_class=soft_degrade. UI treats them as separate flips.
tomas: Repro: trace=tr.67890 -> event1 soft_degrade @14:01, event2 soft_degrade(quota_backfill) @14:01:03.
morgan: Exact. My worry: if we dedupe we lose the telemetry about quota backfill. Maybe mark the second as "reaffirmation" instead of dropping.
sri: I like that. Ingestion can add event_type: initial|reaffirmation and a decision_level int. Console then only counts level==0 for flip totals.
elena: UX: show a small chevron on the timeline entry to reveal reaffirmations, do not bump the flip counter. Also add opt-in retention for reaffirmations.
tomas: Implementation: add idempotency window per-policy (configurable ms). If same (trace_id, decision_class) within window -> mark reaffirmation.
ops-bot: /deploy sri/audit-reaffirmation -> staging queued.
morgan: Action owners: morgan prototype shim, sri ingestion change + feature flag, elena mock UI, tomas evaluator idempotency. I'll draft a 1-pager RFC and link.
